## Digest dir finalized as triefacts/triediffs; since it lives inside the triefact… — 2026-07-25 (parent f884586590ef)

Two performance fixes eliminate redundant filesystem traversal during TypeScript scanning, reducing scan time from ~43s to ~0.2s on large projects.

In `ts_resolve.py`, a new `_PRUNE_DIR_NAMES` constant and `_iter_config_files` function replace unbounded `rglob` calls in `_collect_tsconfigs` and `_collect_workspace_entries`. The pruned `os.walk` never descends into `node_modules`, hidden directories, `build`, or `dist`.

In `typescript_refs.py`, `_RESOLVER_CACHE` and `_shared_resolver` provide a process-level cache keyed by source root. `extract_file_data` now fetches a shared `TsResolver` instance rather than calling `TsResolver.build` fresh for every parsed file, ensuring config discovery runs once per source root per scan.

### Changes

- ~ trie/config:Diff — diffs_dir default becomes triefacts/triediffs.
- + trie/parse/ts_resolve:_iter_config_files — "Walk `source_root` returning sorted paths matching `name_pattern`, skipping `_PRUNE_DIR_NAMES` and hidden directories during traversal."
- ~ trie/parse/ts_resolve:_collect_tsconfigs — Use _iter_config_files instead of rglob-then-filter.
- ~ trie/parse/ts_resolve:_collect_workspace_entries — Use _iter_config_files instead of rglob-then-filter.
- + trie/parse/typescript_refs:_shared_resolver — "Return a cached `TsResolver` for `source_root`, building and storing one on first access."
- + trie/parse/ts_resolve:_PRUNE_DIR_NAMES — "Set of directory names skipped during `os.walk` traversal to avoid descending into vendor and build trees."
- + trie/parse/typescript_refs:_RESOLVER_CACHE — "Module-level cache mapping source-root path strings to their `TsResolver` instances, avoiding redundant config-file walks per scan."
